subject.title: fix(agents): use currentAttemptAssistant for incomplete-turn classification

question: Is source-level terminal proof plus regression coverage sufficient for this message-delivery classifier fix, or should maintainers require a live channel run before merge?
rationale: The code path and tests strongly support the fix, but the affected surface is user-visible final message delivery and the contributor did not rerun the original live WhatsApp/OpenRouter scenario.

options.title: Accept Bounded Source Proof
options.body: Proceed after normal gates if maintainers accept the before/after fixture and regression tests as sufficient for this classifier-only fix.

options.title: Require Live Transport Proof
options.body: Pause merge until a live channel run demonstrates `update_plan` followed by a `stopReason=stop` final answer reaching the user.

recommendation.title: Accept Bounded Source Proof
recommendation.body: Proceed after normal gates if maintainers accept the before/after fixture and regression tests as sufficient for this classifier-only fix.
